description: The axis-aligned box around a part's solid bodies, or an assembly's resolved components' bodies in the assembly's coordinates, in mm. SOLIDWORKS' quick box by default (it may be a little larger than the bodies); precise for the exact one.

document.description: The part or assembly: its title, its full path, or its file name with the extension (e.g. part.SLDPRT, part.SLDDRW), which picks exactly that document. A name several open documents share is refused with the candidates. The active document when absent.

precise.description: Compute the exact box from the bodies' extreme points. Default false.
